item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the node test holding the fleet reading to runs.drain's unreconciled_runs over each pointer shape plus the source pin; the manifest records node test 6 passed, head arm 70 passed EXIT=0 and base arm 64 passed EXIT=0, and I re-ran the node test at the reviewed head to 6 passed.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states node test 6 passed, head arm 70 passed EXIT=0, base arm 64 passed EXIT=0 and negative control 1 failed EXIT=1, but it declares no after_suite field, so the head-arm observation is not in the contract slot the promotion suite-delta read and the review annotation consume.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the five declared paths; the head diff touches exactly reckon/crew/promotion.py (+9/-25), tests/test_the_unreconciled_count_has_one_composition.py (new +151) and docs/evidence/fragments/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner/the-unreconciled-count-has-one-composition.html (new +28), all inside them, and reckon/crew/runs.py is byte-unchanged.

justifications.durability: the change deletes the duplicate composition, so a future edit to the host-gated liveness or the disposition predicate in runs._drain_row reaches both the drain and the promotion counter, and the test pins promotion._drain_row is runs._drain_row plus the _drain_row reference inside each call site's source; the absent after_suite weakens the run's own reproducibility rather than the code.
justifications.evidence: the equivalence is recorded and independently reproduced - the node test 6 passed at the reviewed head, head arm 70 passed EXIT=0 (377.59s) against base arm 64 passed EXIT=0 (406.09s), and my own mutation (the promotion counter given its own copy that reads the stored process_alive instead of the host-gated liveness) reddens exactly the still-working-over-terminal-manifest case EXIT=1; the head arm measured revision 7da2f7989, and the manifest's missing after_suite field is the reproducibility gap.
justifications.fit: the change reuses the private runs helpers as the module already imports _live_worktree_claims and _manifest_freshness from runs, the test follows the node-test idiom of the sibling suite, both commits carry conventional subjects with bodies, and the evidence fragment follows the fragment format (it lacks a trailing newline).
justifications.goal_fidelity: promotion._unreconciled_live_runs now returns sum(1 for pointer in pointers if _drain_row(pointer)['unreconciled']) and _drain_row is the exact function runs.drain builds each row from (reckon/crew/runs.py:1230), so the two readings share one composition by construction rather than by a maintained copy, which is the node's stated goal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the head diff touches exactly three of the five declared write paths - reckon/crew/promotion.py (+9/-25), tests/test_the_unreconciled_count_has_one_composition.py (new +151) and the evidence fragment (new +28) - and reckon/crew/runs.py is unchanged because _drain_row already existed at base a08a2baa, so no out-of-scope file is touched.
